name: cooling
title: Better cooling: measure how the CPU frequency cap and the platform cooling profile limit the sustained speed
parity_check: Not an engine change: the output is identical at every cap; only speed and temperature differ.
notes: Run tools/cooling_kit.py (--caps 2.2,2.4,2.6,2.8, --setup "<physical conditions>", optionally --profiles balanced,performance --apply-profile). Watch the time to 75 and 80 C, the sustained tokens per second at each cap, and whether the fan sensors read at all (a fan at 0 RPM for the whole run is reported as an unreliable sensor). The platform profile belongs to root: the kit prints the sudo command and only runs it with --apply-profile.
